def _sort_key(result: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[float, float]:
    adj = result["adjusted_score"]
    loo = result["loo_predictive_r"]
    if not np.isfinite(adj):
        return (-np.inf, -np.inf)
    if not np.isfinite(loo):
        loo = -np.inf
    return (adj, loo)


def _load_selected_variation_from_sidecar() -> str:
    sidecar = Path(__file__).with_name("results.json")
    if sidecar.exists():
        try:
            payload = json.loads(sidecar.read_text())
            name = payload.get("best_variation")
            if name in VARIATIONS:
                return str(name)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return BASELINE_VARIATION


def compute_donor_score(
    *,
    donor_id: str,
    data_root: str | Path,
):
    data_root = Path(data_root)
    cohort = load_training_cohort(data_root)
    donor_rows = cohort.loc[cohort["donor_id"] == donor_id]
    if donor_rows.empty:
        return None
    slide_name = str(donor_rows.iloc[0]["slide_name"])
    slide_path = data_root / slide_name
    variation = VARIATIONS[_load_selected_variation_from_sidecar()]
    summary = _load_slide_region_class_counts(slide_path)
    comp = _variation_components(summary, variation)
    score = comp["score"]
    if not np.isfinite(score):
        return None
    return float(score)


def run_sweep(data_root: str | Path = "/data") -> dict[str, Any]:
    data_root = Path(data_root)
    features = extract_all_features(data_root)
    results = [evaluate_variation(features, name) for name in VARIATIONS]
    results_sorted = sorted(results, key=_sort_key, reverse=True)
    best = results_sorted[0]

    print("ALL VARIATIONS (sorted by adjusted_score):")
    for res in results_sorted:
        print(
            f"  {res['variation_name']}: adjusted={res['adjusted_score']:.4f} "
            f"(LOO r={res['loo_predictive_r']:.4f}, IS r={res['partial_r']:.4f}, gap={res['gap']:.4f})"
        )

    print()
    print(f"BEST VARIATION: {best['variation_name']}")
    print(f"  IS partial r:      {best['partial_r']:.4f}")

    print(f"  IS-LOO Gap:        {best['gap']:.4f}  (penalty={best['gap_penalty']:.4f})")
    print(f"  Adjusted Score:    {best['adjusted_score']:.4f}")
    print()

    print()

    best_per_donor = pd.DataFrame(best["per_donor"]).sort_values("donor_id").reset_index(drop=True)
    for _, row in best_per_donor.iterrows():
        print(
            f"  {row['donor_id']}  {row['outcome']:.6f}  {row['predicted']:.6f}  "
            f"score={row[best['feature_col']]:.4f}; "
            f"num={int(row[best['numerator_col']])}; den={int(row[best['denominator_col']])}; "
            f"region_cells={int(row[best['region_cells_col']])}"

    donor_feature_table = features[

            best["denominator_col"],
            best["region_cells_col"],
        ]
    ].copy()
    donor_feature_table = donor_feature_table.rename(
        columns={
            best["feature_col"]: "feature_value",
            best["numerator_col"]: "numerator_count",
            best["denominator_col"]: "denominator_count",
            best["region_cells_col"]: "region_cells",
        }
    )
    donor_feature_table.to_csv(Path("/scratch/donor_feature_table.csv"), index=False)

    payload = {
        "best_variation": best["variation_name"],
        "baseline_variation": BASELINE_VARIATION,
        "feature_name": best["variation_name"],
        "feature_col": "feature_value",
        "metrics": {
            "adjusted_score": best["adjusted_score"],
            "partial_r": best["partial_r"],
            "loo_predictive_r": best["loo_predictive_r"],
            "gap": best["gap"],
            "gap_penalty": best["gap_penalty"],
            "ci_lo": best["ci_lo"],
            "ci_hi": best["ci_hi"],
            "p_value": best["p_value"],
            "n_analyzable": best["n_analyzable"],
            "loo_unstable_count": best["loo_unstable_count"],
            "loo_max_shift": best["loo_max_shift"],
        },
        "variation_rankings": [
            {
                "variation_name": res["variation_name"],
                "adjusted_score": res["adjusted_score"],
                "partial_r": res["partial_r"],
                "loo_predictive_r": res["loo_predictive_r"],
                "gap": res["gap"],
                "gap_penalty": res["gap_penalty"],
                "n_analyzable": res["n_analyzable"],

        "best_variation_spec": {

            "denominator_type": VARIATIONS[best["variation_name"]].denominator_type,

        },

    Path("/scratch/results.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))

    return {
        "features": features,
        "results": results_sorted,
        "best": best,
        "payload": payload,
